faults.title: Centre-console and dashboard rattles
faults.description: Some third-generation A-Class cars develop rattles around the dashboard or centre console. Listen on uneven roads and have loose trim or fittings identified before replacing components.

faults.title: Intermittent electrical issues
faults.description: Electrical problems were a recurring owner complaint for the 2012–2018 A-Class. Test the displays, switches and other equipment; have a recurring fault diagnosed rather than relying on a reset.
